description: This is a Java interface defining contract for guarantor write operations in a loan management system. It declares methods for creating, updating, and removing guarantors associated with a loan.

methods.name: createGuarantor
methods.description: Creates a new guarantor for a loan identified by loanId using data from JsonCommand.

methods.name: updateGuarantor
methods.description: Updates an existing guarantor identified by guarantorId for a loan identified by loanId with data from JsonCommand.

methods.name: removeGuarantor
methods.description: Removes a guarantor identified by guarantorId and associated funding id from a loan.
